points.description: States that the statement is TRUE.

Justifies this by stating that the parent and child are separate (different) processes, so the parent can perform any operation, including exec, without waiting for the child to terminate. Equivalent wording earns the mark. A bare 'TRUE' with no valid justification earns no marks for this point.

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a justification that parent and child are independent processes, so the parent can call exec regardless of the child's state. The TRUE answer earns 0.5 only; the justification carries the majority of marks, matching the rule that no correct justification means no marks. A FALSE answer, or a justification that does not rely on the parent and child being separate processes, earns no marks.
